ranges.name: Engaged
ranges.means: Toe to toe with someone in your zone

ranges.name: Far
ranges.who: Guns at Disadvantage (rifles and Specialists ignore this)

ranges.name: Out of reach
ranges.who: Nobody, unless a power says so

tags.name: Cover
tags.text: Take Cover (Quick Action) gives +2 Guard until your next turn. You can Vanish here.

tags.name: High Ground
tags.text: Ranged attacks from it get Edge. Melee can't reach you unless the attacker climbs up first, which is a move or, on a hard climb, a roll.

tags.name: Dark
tags.text: Ranged attacks in or into the zone are at Disadvantage. You can Vanish here.

tags.name: Cramped
tags.text: Heavy melee and long guns are at Disadvantage, and no more than two people can be engaged with any one person.

tags.name: Hazard
tags.text: Any missed roll in this zone costs 1 Harm, heroes and villains alike. Fire, traffic, a live wire.

tags.name: Crowd
tags.text: You can Vanish here. Guns fired into a Crowd risk hitting bystanders (a fair GM move on any miss).
